==Description==
'''E-90''' will be the 5th entity you will encounter in [[Section E]], where the player must avoid looking at the instance. More info on '''E-90''' is shown below.

==Mechanics==
'''E-90''' will play an audible whistle before placing itself in the far distance in a random direction, if the player looks at it for too long, the player’s vision will darken until '''E-90''' suddenly charges at the player, blinding and stunning them.

==Strategies==
* Spin around once you hear '''E-90''' spawn, then refuse to look at '''E-90''''s direction once you locate it.
* '''E-90''' doesn’t attack immediately, use that to your advantage.

==Trivia==
* '''E-90''' is the only 3D entity in the game that isn't made of effects.
* '''E-90''' was inspired off of an easter egg in Sonic Saves Robloxia.
* Originally, '''E-90''' was named '''E-5''' in their suggestion, this was changed due to clutter with [[E-10]].
* '''E-90''' was almost going to be 2D, however was made 3D in an attempt to make them more unique and stand out from the rest of the entities. 
* '''E-90''', despite having wings, is flightless, and is merely an apparition.
